$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Font library
blocks.licence: OFL-1.1 or Apache-2.0, as each family's folder in the google/fonts repository says. Most faces are Google Fonts' own Latin builds; a face whose licence reserves its name ships as the original file from that repository, and the faces for other alphabets come from there too, the CJK ones cut to size
blocks.for: Every bundled typeface, with its alphabets, a preview family name and a check for whether it can write a given text. Shown to people through the Font chooser.

blocks.name: Font import
blocks.for: Bring in a customer's own .ttf, .otf, .woff or a .zip of them; the id is a fingerprint of the bytes, so a saved project finds it again.

blocks.name: Text to outlines
blocks.for: Lay out one or two lines of text in any bundled or imported font and return the letter outlines in millimetres, for laser or 3D alike.

blocks.name: Symbol font: Material Symbols
blocks.for: About 1,500 symbols customers can type into their text, grouped and searchable; shown through the Symbol picker.
